COD.rationale: Content (red) is identified with literal position mappings, the same referent has an explicit origin/status entry, and organization/presentation is shown by position mappings, satisfying C,O,D for a current referent.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition linked to an identified content's organization/presentation/access was found.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content identifiers with attributes (red/blue) and literal position sets are present (e.g. p*/current/n*/red=...).

D.rationale: Separate origin/status fields (kinds: copied_prior_record, completed_record, history_estimate, command_estimate) distinguish content identity from status/source.

O.rationale: The report gives explicit position/structure mappings and a layout rule, describing how contents are presented/organized (node-wise position sets and grid orientation).
